_comment: Template for the download step. Copy to release/downloads-manifest.json and
fill in the published artifacts; that file is local and stays out of Git.
Every field below is required except the optional metadata ones. bytes and
sha256 are checked against the source file before anything is written.
signature and notarization must describe THIS file: the script derives the
real state from the bytes (codesign, stapler, PE certificate table) and
fails when the manifest disagrees in either direction. Calling a notarized
Developer ID build "unsigned" is rejected just like the reverse.
Accepted macOS signature values: Developer ID Application, Apple
Development, ad-hoc, unsigned. Accepted macOS notarization: notarized,
not-notarized. Accepted Windows signature values: authenticode-sha256,
unsigned. Windows notarization is always not-applicable.
Any other value fails instead of passing unchecked.
Names must be bare, unique filenames; DOWNLOADS.json and SHA256SUMS.txt are
written by the script and cannot be used as artifact names.
Fields other than source are carried into DOWNLOADS.json unchanged, so
publisher, certificateThumbprint, sourceCommit, buildRunId, timestamp and
similar provenance survive publication. Never copy these values from
another release.
Reference values for 0.9.4 live in the publication receipts under
.local-work/candidates/, not here.
